description: This file defines a REST API resource for managing 'hooks' in an application, providing endpoints to create, retrieve, update, delete, and obtain templates for hooks. It uses JAX-RS annotations and integrates with the Fineract platform's security, command processing, and serialization services.
external_methods: this.toApiJsonSerializer.serialize(settings, hooks or hook or result, RESPONSE_DATA_PARAMETERS)

classes.name: HookApiResource
classes.description: REST resource class providing API endpoints for managing hooks, including retrieval, creation, update, deletion, and obtaining templates.

methods.name: retrieveHooks
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a list of all hooks.

methods.name: retrieveHook
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve details of a specific hook by ID.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a template for creating a new hook.

methods.name: createHook
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new hook with specified parameters.

methods.name: updateHook
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update the details of an existing hook.

methods.name: deleteHook
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a hook by ID.
